description: New revenue-critical endpoint ships with no SLO, error budget, or runbook. High reliability risk; escalate. Grounds: 'SLOs defined for every critical user journey', 'runbooks for high-risk components'.
input: PR introduces a checkout-capture endpoint on the money path; there is no defined SLO or error budget, no severity classification, and no runbook for when it fails.

expected.recommend: define an availability/latency SLO with an error budget, a severity tier, and a runbook before this critical-path endpoint launches

description: Change removes a standby region's failover path with no RTO/RPO or DR consideration. High-risk resilience gap; escalate. Grounds: 'Disaster recovery: define RTO/RPO per service tier, practice failover'.
input: IaC PR decommissions the warm-standby replica in the secondary region to cut cost, with no updated RTO/RPO targets, no failover test, and no note on blast radius if the primary region degrades.

expected.recommend: restore or re-plan a failover path with explicit RTO/RPO targets and a practiced failover test before removing the standby; quantify the single-region blast radius

description: Postmortem uses blame language and lists no action items with owners. Blameless-culture and follow-through gap. Grounds: 'Blameless postmortems: timeline, root cause, action items with owners and deadlines'.
input: PR adds a postmortem doc that attributes the outage to 'the engineer who pushed the bad config' and closes with 'be more careful'; it has no timeline, no contributing factors, and no action items with owners or deadlines.

expected.recommend: rewrite blamelessly around a timeline, root cause, and contributing factors, and add action items with named owners and deadlines

description: Chaos experiment proposed directly in production with no steady-state hypothesis or blast-radius bound. High-risk; escalate. Grounds: 'Chaos: steady-state hypothesis, minimize blast radius, safety gates'.
input: PR adds a scheduled job that terminates random production pods across all services during business hours, with no steady-state hypothesis, no blast-radius scoping, and no abort/rollback gate.

expected.recommend: gate the experiment behind a steady-state hypothesis, a minimized blast radius (single service/off-peak), and an automatic abort before running any prod chaos
